title: Word add-in rebuilt from the ground up
summary: The Word add-in is rebuilt. Edits now land in your document as tracked changes you review the way you always have.
body_markdown:
We’ve rebuilt the Parachute Word add-in so it works the way the web app does.


## Edits land in the document


- Ask for a change and it arrives in your document as a normal Word tracked change.
- Review, accept and reject in Word, the way you always have. No side panel, and no inserting suggestions one at a time.
- Your styles, numbering and fonts come through untouched.


## The full Parachute, inside Word


The add-in now runs on the same AI as the web app, so edits in Word match what you get in the browser. Precedents, style profiles and attachments work from Word too.


[Set up the Word add-in](https://help.goparachute.ai/integrations/microsoft-word/)
